state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

A reload now drains the connections the old tree accepted, the way a stop does (`rule:concurrency/a-drain-closes-a-connection-cleanly`). `nvs_server::Generations` on `Serving` holds one drain per published tree; `Process::published` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/control.rs` retires the older trees after the publish, and an accept loop that sees a newer tree first does the same. A connection reads `nvs_runtime::Drain::any_of` over the server's drain and its tree's drain. The health probe and `Core\Server::isDraining()` still read the process drain only. Gap `a-reload-closes-no-connection` is deleted.

The `nvs-diagnostics`, `benches`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-db`, `nvs-ir`, `nvs-config` and `nvs-server` gap directories are closed for this goal. One `nvs-syntax` gap is left, `the-pipeline-bench-has-no-nested-twin`, which is a bench member in a different file set.

In `nvs-cli`, three gaps name this goal, and the other subcommands' `--help` text has not been swept and is still in the dense voice.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes (module doc of `tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`). A person has to push, so no session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest of the gaps across many crates: `nvs-host` (4), `nvs-lsp` (5), `nvs-runtime` and `nvs-stdlib` the largest. Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", as the goal's § *Stage 4* defines it. `bun nv import` is broken because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6, as expected.
